tool_description: This API helps to query properties for sale or rent in France to create a real estate site/application such as seloger.com
name: Seloger
title: Seloger

api_list.name: properties/count
api_list.description: Count total properties returned with options and filters

required_parameters.name: zipCodes
required_parameters.description: Either zipCodes OR districtIds parameter is required. The postal code, separated by comma for multiple values. Ex : 75,13,...

optional_parameters.name: bedrooms
optional_parameters.description: Filter by number of bedrooms (1-5). Separated by comma for multiple values. Ex : 2,3

optional_parameters.name: maximumLivingArea
optional_parameters.description: Filter by maximum living area

optional_parameters.name: rooms
optional_parameters.description: Filter by number of rooms (1-5). Separated by comma for multiple values. Ex : 2,3

optional_parameters.name: maximumGroundArea
optional_parameters.description: Filter by maximum ground area

optional_parameters.name: sortBy
optional_parameters.description: One of the following : 0-Pertinence | 1-Prix croissant | 2-Prix decroissant | 10-Du + recent au + ancien | 9-Du + ancien au + recent | 5-Surface croissante | 6-Surface decroissante

optional_parameters.name: includeNewConstructions
optional_parameters.description: Whether or not includes new constructions in listing

optional_parameters.name: maximumPrice
optional_parameters.description: Filter by maximum price

optional_parameters.name: transactionType
optional_parameters.description: One of the following : 1-Louer | 2-Acheter | 5-Viager | 6-Investir

optional_parameters.name: minimumGroundArea
optional_parameters.description: Filter by minimum ground area

optional_parameters.name: minimumFloor
optional_parameters.description: Filter by minimum number of floors

optional_parameters.name: districtIds
optional_parameters.description: Either zipCodes OR districtIds parameter is required. The value of id fields under 'districts' JSON object returned in .../locations/search endpoint. Separated by comma for multiple values. Ex : 133051,133137,...

optional_parameters.name: minimumLivingArea
optional_parameters.description: Filter by minimum living area

optional_parameters.name: maximumFloor
optional_parameters.description: Filter by maximum number of floors

optional_parameters.name: realtyTypes
